summary: Preferred Stock Distributions Declared Through January 31, 2027 CHICAGO --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 16, 2026-- OFS Credit Company, Inc. body_text: Preferred Stock Distributions Declared Through January 31, 2027 CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 16, 2026-- OFS Credit Company, Inc. (Nasdaq: OCCI, OCCIM, OCCIN) (“OFS Credit,” the “Company,” “we,” “us” or “our”), an investment company that primarily invests in collateralized loan obligation (“CLO”) equity and debt securities, today announced that its board of directors (the “Board”) declared a cash distribution of $0.05 per share of common stock for the month of August 2026. The Board has also declared monthly cash distributions for the Company’s 5.25% Series E Term Preferred Stock, 7.875% Series F Term Preferred Stock and 8.00% Series G Term Preferred Stock through January 31, 2027. Given that the shares of 5.25% Series E Term Preferred Stock are mandatorily redeemable on December 31, 2026, dividends for this series of Preferred Stock have been declared up to, but not including, its date of redemption. Common Stock Distribution The following schedule applies to the common stock (Nasdaq: OCCI) distribution for common stockholders of record on the close of business of the record date: Month Record Date Payment Date Cash Distribution Per Share August 2026 August 14, 2026 August 31, 2026 $0.05 Dividend Reinvestment Plan (“DRIP”) – DRIP Shares Issued at 95% of Market Price Common stockholders who participate in our DRIP have the opportunity to receive a 5% discount to the market price per share of common stock at the close of regular trading on The Nasdaq Capital Market on the valuation date fixed by the Board for each distribution (i.e., the payment date). Common stockholders that are interested in participating in our DRIP should contact their broker or financial intermediary. Additional information about our DRIP and how to participate can be found at https://ir.ofscreditcompany.com/shareholder-services/dividend-reinvestment-plan . We make our website content available for informational purposes only. It should not be relied upon for investment purposes, nor is it incorporated by reference into this press release. title: How to Get an Internship at Oracle 2026-2027
summary: Explore Oracle internships by eligibility, role, pay, timing, and interview preparation, and various recruitment routes.
body_text: Live Oracle internships and training routes 31 exact-company opportunities · 7 representative routes shown · verified July 28, 2026 Twenty-one current openings belong to the Oracle Veteran Internship Program. General student routes appear first below, and the OVIP example is labeled. Software Engineer Intern Bachelor's · Austin / San Carlos · $19.61-$53/hr Site Reliability Engineer Intern Bachelor's · San Carlos · $19.62-$53/hr Undergrad Applications Developer Intern Bachelor's · Remote US · $19.62-$53/hr Data Analyst Intern Bachelor's · Nashville · $18.17-$34.62/hr Advanced Degree Software Engineer Intern Master's · California · $18.17-$34.62/hr Catalyst Velocity Data Center Technician Associate's / open-access · Allen · $13.03-$24.81/hr AI Agent Intern OVIP · Austin · $19.09-$36.35/hr See every live Oracle opening on Simplify → To get an Oracle internship, first choose the eligibility route and the part of Oracle you want to work on. A college student applying to software development needs different evidence from an OCI operations candidate, a Nashville Software School participant, or someone eligible for Oracle's veteran internship program. What You Should Know About Oracle Internships Check eligibility before counting openings. Twenty-one of 31 active Oracle internship-tagged opportunities are OVIP roles for transitioning service members or military spouses. Oracle internships extend well beyond databases. Current routes cover software, applications, site reliability, analytics, and data-center operations. Oracle's recurring product-development program also names UX, product, project management, and PhD research. Compare pay by requisition. Every current Oracle opportunity reviewed here exposes posted pay, but the range changes substantially by route, location, and degree level. Oracle Internships at a Glance Question What students should know What is open now? 31 US internships or training routes were active on July 28, 2026. Twenty-one are restricted to OVIP; the other ten represent nine distinct titles after one duplicate. Who can apply? The route controls. Current openings include Bachelor's and Master's student roles, an associate-degree or open-access data-center route, a bootcamp-linked pathway, and OVIP for transitioning service members or military spouses. When do roles open? There is no universal date. In this snapshot, general software and analytics roles appeared from fall through early spring, followed by data-center training and OVIP on separate schedules. Are Oracle internships paid? Every active opportunity reviewed here exposes employer-posted hourly pay. The representative general routes range from $13.03 to $53 per hour. What is the internship experience like? Oracle describes product-development interns contributing to team projects with training and mentorship. The day-to-day work still depends on the team: building software, operating cloud services, analyzing data, or maintaining infrastructure. What matters most: Oracle does not have one interchangeable intern pool. Degree-based student programs, data-center training, Nashville Software School Pathways, and OVIP use different eligibility rules and lead to different work. What the experience is designed to provide: Oracle emphasizes contribution, learning, and mentorship rather than observation alone. OVIP and data-center routes add their own structured training. What about work-life balance? Oracle does not publish one intern schedule, flexibility policy, or work-life rating. Follow the location, working arrangement, term, and operating expectations in the requisition; SRE and data-center work can have different constraints from applications development. When Do Oracle Internship Applications Open? Oracle does not publish one universal US application date. Current posting history shows general student software and applications openings arriving from October 2025 through March 2026 for the 2026 cycle. The current Data Analyst role appeared in February, data-center training appeared in April and June, and a large OVIP group appeared in May. Those are separate recruiting patterns, not one Oracle deadline. A software internship designed around an academic term does not share a dependable schedule with OVIP or a three-month data-center training cohort. The current Catalyst route, for example, names anticipated August 31 or November 9, 2026 start dates, while several student software roles name May-August or June-September 2026. Use the Summer 2027 internship application timeline to prepare in advance, then let the dates and enrollment language on each Oracle requisition control. 📅 An active posting is not automatically a 2027 internship. One current SRE opening targets students graduating between December 2026 and May 2027, but most explicitly dated student opportunities in this snapshot still describe 2026. What Internships Does Oracle Offer? Oracle's official product-development internship page names Software Engineering, User Experience, Program and Project Management, Product Management, and PhD Research as recurring paths. The current US openings concentrate in four practical families. Software and Applications Development Oracle software interns can work on cloud applications, databases and systems, industry products, customer-success tools, and development platforms. Best proof: working code plus testing, debugging, one technical tradeoff, and a measured result. Cloud Reliability and Infrastructure OCI and cloud-service teams keep production systems available through monitoring, incident response, automation, networking, compute, storage, and security. This work is closer to operating a distributed service than shipping a feature in isolation. Best proof: a deployed system where you added observability, automated an operation, diagnosed a failure, or improved recovery, latency, or reliability. Data and Analytics Oracle analytics work connects data to an operating or product decision. The current Nashville route supports performance management, process improvement, automation, and compliance; Oracle's wider product map includes analytics platforms, data warehouses, visualization, and databases. Best proof: a reproducible analysis documenting the question, cleaning, method, validation, and decision that followed. Data Center Operations and Alternative Routes Infrastructure routes cover server and network hardware, cabling, break/fix, asset control, monitoring, power, cooling, safety, and operating procedures. Catalyst, Data Center Trainee, Nashville Software School Pathways, and OVIP have different entry requirements. Best proof: hands-on troubleshooting, hardware repair, networking, inventory accuracy, safety, or a clear operational runbook. Software and Applications Development The work. Current software openings span Customer Success Services, Consumer Industries, Global Industry Units, and enterprise cloud applications. An intern may write and test code, debug a customer-facing service, improve a platform, or integrate AI features. The business unit determines the system, users, and constraints. Who fits and what to show. Current student routes name computer science or related technical study. Oracle lists Java, C/C++, C#, JavaScript, Go, Python, SQL, operating systems, and frameworks as examples, not one universal checklist. Explain one project's architecture, your code ownership, testing, a failure you traced, and what improved. Current evidence and preparation. Representative openings include Software Engineer Intern at $19.61-$53 per hour and Undergrad Applications Developer Intern at $19.62-$53. Prepare to discuss the language and system named in your posting, then walk through a design or debugging decision you personally made. Cloud Reliability and Infrastructure The work. Oracle's current Site Reliability Engineer Intern combines development and operations: monitoring events, administering services, offering mitigations, following incident procedures, and writing automation. Think service ownership: detect, reduce impact, recover, and prevent repetition. Who fits and what to show. The role targets US university students in computer science, IT, or another technical discipline with an expected graduation date between December 2026 and May 2027. Strong proof could be a service with dashboards and alerts, a Linux automation tool, a postmortem, or a project where you diagnosed and recovered from an outage. Current evidence and preparation. The San Carlos posting lists $19.62-$53 per hour and no sponsorship for that requisition. Review cloud fundamentals, Linux, networking, monitoring, scripting, and one incident. Ask whether the interview emphasizes coding, operations, systems knowledge, or a mixture. Data and Analytics The work. The current Data Analyst Intern supports North America operations through insights, automation, performance management, process improvement, and compliance. The output is a clearer decision or better-running process, not a model for its own sake. Who fits and what to show. The posting names Bachelor's study in computer science, data science, IT, business, or a related field, plus interest in machine learning and generative AI tools. Use a project where the metric and recommendation mattered. Show how you cleaned the data, tested the method, handled an edge case, and communicated the result to someone making a decision. Current evidence and preparation. The Nashville role lists $18.17-$34.62 per hour, May-August 2026, and no sponsorship for that requisition. Prepare data manipulation, analytical reasoning, and an explanation of how an analysis changed a process. Data Center Operations and Alternative Routes The work. Oracle's Catalyst route covers servers, storage, networking, cabling, hardware lifecycle work, break/fix, inventory, and troubleshooting. Other routes include Data Center Trainee, Nashville Software School Pathways, and the quarter-long OVIP. The training is structured, but the work is operational and hands-on. Who fits and what to show. These are not interchangeable student internships. Catalyst can fit associate-degree or hands-on technical candidates; the trainee route welcomes varied backgrounds; Pathways requires the named bootcamp; OVIP is for transitioning service members and military spouses. Match your evidence to the route: hardware repair, networking, ticket triage, asset accuracy, safety, or translating military experience into an operational result. Current evidence and preparation. The Catalyst Velocity Data Center Technician lists $13.03-$24.81 per hour and later-2026 starts. The AI Agent Intern is an OVIP example at $19.09-$36.35. Prepare one troubleshooting or operational story with the symptom, checks, action, and verified outcome. How Hard Is It to Get an Oracle Internship, and What Does It Pay? Oracle does not publish a verified US internship acceptance rate or applicant count. The practical difficulty is whether you clear the route-specific eligibility and can show evidence for the exact team. A headline count of 31 sounds broad, but 21 openings are restricted to OVIP and the ten remaining opportunities reduce to nine distinct titles. Every active Oracle opportunity in this snapshot has posted hourly pay. Representative student software and SRE roles reach $53 per hour; the current Data Analyst and Master's software examples list up to $34.62; Catalyst lists $13.03-$24.81. These are requisition examples, not one universal Oracle intern rate. Location, route, degree level, and team affect the band. How Do I Apply to Oracle? Choose the correct route first. Separate degree-based student internships from Catalyst, Data Center Trainee, Nashville Software School Pathways, and OVIP. A title containing “intern” does not make every applicant eligible. Pick the product or operating surface. Decide whether your strongest evidence fits applications development, cloud reliability, data and analytics, or infrastructure operations. Use the requisition to identify the actual Oracle business unit. Match one project to the work. Software candidates should surface code, testing, and debugging. SRE candidates need reliability or automation. Analytics candidates need a decision-oriented analysis. Data-center applicants need hands-on troubleshooting or operational evidence. Rewrite the top third of your resume. Put the relevant project, tools, constraint, and result where a recruiter can find them quickly. Do not lead with a general statement about liking Oracle or cloud technology. Check enrollment, graduation, location, and work authorization separately. Several current student postings require enrollment before and after the internship. Some current roles explicitly say sponsorship is unavailable, but that is requisition-level evidence, not a companywide rule. Track each requisition and resume version. Oracle has similar titles across different organizations, degree levels, locations, and routes. Save the role, submitted resume, term, and evidence you emphasized. Keep Oracle's overlapping routes from becoming one messy application list. Track the business area, eligibility route, location, term, pay band, and resume version for each Oracle requisition. Simplify's tracker keeps those details together while you complete the forms. Track your Oracle applications → How to Prepare for an Oracle Internship Interview Oracle does not publish one universal internship interview sequence. Its official interview preparation guide tells candidates to ask whether the interview will be technical or behavioral, prepare role-specific evidence, know their resume, research the relevant business area, and clarify next steps. Prepare for the work in your requisition. Software applicants should practice explaining code, algorithms, testing, databases, and debugging choices supported by their own projects. SRE candidates should cover Linux, networking, monitoring, automation, and incident reasoning. Analytics candidates should explain data quality, method selection, validation, and the decision their work supported. Infrastructure candidates should rehearse hardware, safety, troubleshooting, or operational scenarios. Connect behavioral stories to Oracle's working context. A useful answer shows how you learned an unfamiliar system, worked with a mentor or teammate, questioned an assumption, recovered from a problem, or improved a process with evidence. Oracle recommends the Situation, Task, Action, Result structure and asks candidates to make their individual contribution clear rather than hiding it inside “we.” Use the SWE interview preparation roadmap for technical practice and this guide to behavioral answers that do not sound rehearsed for story structure. 💡 Ask the recruiter what this team evaluates. A Customer Success Services developer, OCI reliability intern, analyst, and data-center trainee should not prepare for one imaginary companywide loop. Frequently Asked Questions Is it hard to get an Oracle internship? Oracle does not publish a verified US internship acceptance rate. The challenge is route-specific: applicants must meet the exact enrollment, degree, location, and work-authorization requirements and then show evidence relevant to the team. Do Oracle interns get paid? Yes. Every active Oracle opportunity in Simplify's July 28 snapshot exposes employer-posted hourly pay. Representative routes range from $13.03-$24.81 for Catalyst to as much as $53 per hour for selected student software and SRE openings. When do Oracle internship applications open? Oracle does not publish one universal US date. In the current snapshot, general software and applications roles appeared from fall through early spring for the 2026 cycle, while data-center training and OVIP followed separate schedules. What's the easiest way to get an Oracle internship? There is no verified shortcut. Choose the route whose eligibility and work match your background, put one relevant project or operational result near the top of your resume, and apply to the exact requisition. What is the Oracle Veteran Internship Program? OVIP is a quarter-long internship for transitioning service members and military spouses moving into corporate work. Oracle says it includes hands-on training across areas such as technology, data, logistics, HR, and sales; general college applicants should not count OVIP postings as ordinary student openings. Does Oracle sponsor international students for internships? Oracle does not publish one universal internship-sponsorship rule. Several current US roles, including the Data Analyst and SRE openings reviewed here, explicitly say sponsorship is unavailable, so applicants must follow the work-authorization language on each requisition. For another large technical internship ecosystem, see how Google internships work . title: Mathos AI Vs. Mathful: Which AI Math Solver is Better?
summary: Introducing the best AI math solver for your needs! In this comparison, we analyze Mathos AI and Mathful to determine which one stands out in solving math problems.
body_text: When it comes to solving math problems, students and professionals often turn to popular math tools like Desmos , Photomath , and Mathway . They are far from inexperienced as far as well-known platforms are concerned; they have become first-stop resources for people who want to ease their problems in math and with the promise of quick solutions and step-by-step solutions. However, due to the compounding demand for ultra-personalized experiences, a new wave of AI-powered math solvers has emerged. Two prominent tools in this space are Mathos AI and Mathful , each with unique features designed to assist students at all levels. Which AI math solver is better: Mathos AI vs. Mathful. In this article, we’ll compare Mathos AI and Mathful, exploring their features and strengths and how each can enhance your math learning experience. And, stay tuned—later in our blog section, we’ll compare Mathos and Symbolab, and more to help you find the perfect math tool for your needs. Mathful Vs. Mathos AI: Feature Comparison Mathful and Mathos AI are two prominent AI-powered math tools designed to assist students in solving math problems, enhance their learning experience, and offer step-by-step explanations. The tools try to simplify mathematics in their way and differ considerably in their feature sets, which suit different kinds of user-specific needs. What Both Tools Offer Problem Solving: Both tools can be used in different topics of mathematics, such as basic arithmetic, and further areas, like trigonometry and prime numbers. Step-by-Step Explanations: They give detailed explanations of what our students need to do to solve the problems. Easy-to-Use Designs: They both have intuitive designs that make them usable by learners at all levels. How Mathful and Mathos AI Differ Feature Mathful Mathos AI Accuracy Reliable for standard problems but may struggle with highly complex or advanced topics. 20% higher accuracy than competitors, excelling in advanced topics like Laplace transforms. Customization Provides general explanations that are suitable for most students. Tailored explanations that adapt to individual learning styles and paces. Range of Topics Focuses on core mathematics topics up to calculus. Covers a wider range, including specialized areas like eigenvalues, scientific notation, and more. Input Methods Primarily supports text input with limited image recognition. Offers text, voice, image, and drawing inputs for versatile problem-solving. Device Synchronization Limited cross-device support, requiring manual transitions between devices. Fully synced across devices, allowing seamless problem-solving anytime, anywhere. Graphing Tools Basic graphing capabilities suitable for common equations. Advanced graphing tools for systems of equations, inequalities, and more. Additional Resources Lacks integration with external resources for extra practice. Links to YouTube videos and similar questions for extended learning opportunities. Homework Helper No dedicated homework uploading or PDF-solving features. Advanced PDF Homework Helper that provides instant solutions and detailed explanations. Specialized Calculators Limited calculators for common topics. Dedicated calculators for various topics, including fractions, determinants, and integrals. Mathful Handles 10+ Math Branches, but Mathos AI Excels with Advanced Topics Mathful supports a broad spectrum of mathematical disciplines, including Algebra, English, Word problems, Geometry, and elementary math. That's why if you're doing standard math homework, this is a good one. However, Mathos AI has a significant edge with its ability to solve more advanced problems, including Laplace transforms , eigenvalues , and scientific notation . Its specialized calculators for polynomial equations , double integrals, and determinants give it the versatility that Mathful cannot match. Mathful’s Step-by-Step Guidance is Helpful, but Mathos AI’s Explanations are More Adaptive Mathful provides clear and structured step-by-step solutions, making it a reliable tool for students seeking guidance on standard math problems. However, Mathos AI doesn’t only give you step-by-step solutions but customizes them depending on your speed and manner of learning. This also means that you can intervene at any point and ask for follow-up questions if you have stopped understanding some steps, and as a bonus, you get similar questions and links to YouTube math videos from teachers that explain the same topic. Mathos AI also has a special graphing calculator to help you visualize linear equations in a super easy way if you’re working on graphs. This makes Mathos AI a better choice for learners who require a more personalized and comprehensive approach. Let's ask Mathful and Mathos AI the same question to see how they perform: Find the domain of y=3x−24x+1y = \frac{3x - 2}{4x + 1} y = 4 x + 1 3 x − 2 ​ . Mathful's answer: Mathful's answer to finding the domain of a rational function. Mathos AI's answer: Mathos AI solves for finding the domain of a rational function. Mathos AI's answer to finding the domain of a rational function. Mathful Has a Photo Math Solver Mathful's photo math solver showcase. Mathful’s photo solver feature offers a quick and convenient way for users to solve math problems. This functionality, combined with Mathful’s simple and user-friendly interface, ensures that students can easily input problems via text or image, streamlining their math-solving process. The details of this tool are practical to the trivial input methods it can process. However, it cannot do anything beyond that. However, Mathful's Photomath function is not allowed with the free version. Mathos AI Offers More Versatile Input Options While Mathful’s photo solver is useful, Mathos AI takes accessibility to the next level with a broader range of input methods. In addition to supporting text and image uploads, Mathos AI allows users to input problems through voice and even drawing. The list of these various options allows us to work on more complex problems or try to handle handwritten queries for a broader range of user needs. Mathos AI's ways to input math question. Mathos AI also simplifies the process of typing and editing math formulas with a built-in math keyboard featuring standard symbols and letters. Entering and making changes to problems using this tool is a snap, especially when the problem requires exact formatting, as in the case of parametric equations . In addition, users can copy some portions of the AI-generated answers and ask follow-up questions, making the problem-solving experience more interactive and smooth. Mathos AI’s PDF Homework Helper allows you to upload PDFs to solve your PDF-based homework. It can act as your digital notebook, solve math problems directly on PDFs with circles around questions, and get step-by-step solutions. Additionally, you can modify, annotate, and take notes on your study materials so you capture key explanations when you read them, for ready reference later. Use Mathos AI's PDF homework helper to circle a math question. Whether you’re tackling algebraic expressions , Laplace transforms , or geometry, Mathos AI’s PDF Editor and AI homework helper make studying smarter and more efficient. Using this all-in-one tool, enjoy easy learning by converting and managing your PDF documents and your notebooks online. Mathful Has an AI Math Solver for Quick Solutions Mathful's math AI tool web page. Mathful's AI math solver allows users to input math problems directly into the interface, providing solutions in seconds. This one boasts an impressive 98% accuracy rate when it comes to correctly answering math problems and explaining your reasoning for some. As it is available around the clock, students who need quick solutions can trust that it is reliable and available at any time of day or night. Mathos AI has an AI Tutor Available 24/7 for Personalized Learning Mathos AI's AI tutor to answer questions. While Mathos AI also provides quick solutions and high accuracy, what truly sets it apart is its ability to offer a personalized, AI tutor experience. Unlike Mathful, Mathos AI adapts to individual learning styles, providing step-by-step explanations tailored to the user’s pace. It's a wonderful resource, a knowledgeable math teacher on demand, any time of day. This advanced feature will read education material, handwriting, and input methods seamlessly and interactively. Be it some seemly difficult square root problem or you’re just trying to figure out all the intricacies around trigonometry, the AI tutor’s present with you as you go along, explains everything so you can understand it the way you understand and at your pace. Mathos AI provides real-time feedback and explanations, always keeping you from being stuck or left behind in your maths learning, and with 24/7 support that’s as close to a personal tutor as you can get from a piece of technology. See how it works exactly in this video: https://youtu.be/DsL6VdwlhiI Mathful Has a Correct Calculator Mathful's math calculator. Mathful’s MathGPT function includes a reliable calculator that caters to a relatively broad spectrum of math topics. The keyboard on these models enables you to tap in the letters and numbers to input problems, which is great for elementary math and pre-algebra and word problems that require detailed, step-by-step solutions. This step-by-step calculator allows users to simplify complex math equations into teachable components completely and instantly accurately for merely any level of math number. Mathos AI Excels with 40+ Dedicated Math Problem-Solving Calculators Mathos AI's dedicated math calculators. Mathos AI surpasses Mathful by offering a comprehensive suite of specialized calculators designed for solving diverse and advanced math problems. While this collection of tools is growing, it includes a fraction of scientific calculations and algebra . It also allows for advanced topics, like matrix multiplication, systems of equations , and integrals . Each calculator is built with precision and undergoes rigorous testing to ensure accuracy, making Mathos AI a dependable resource for quick, reliable solutions. In addition to that, calculators on the site are universally accessible need no registration, and offer unrestricted use. Mathos AI transforms problem-solving into a seamless experience, cementing its position as a one-stop platform for all mathematical needs. Mathful Provides Standard Resources Mathful offers a solid foundation for students seeking accurate and timely math solutions. Our step-by-step calculator and MathGPT integration users can solve problems at all grade levels across all topics such as algebra and calculus. Mathful's ability to provide relatively quick, detailed solutions ensures that students receive the help they need without delay, enabling them to complete assignments efficiently. Text or image upload is one of the many input methods supported by the platform for solving different types of math questions. However, Mathful's daily limit for math question input is very limited when you're using a free plan. Mathos AI Enhances Learning with Extra Materials Mathos AI offers supplementary resources. While Mathful provides reliable explanations, Mathos AI takes learning a step further by offering a wealth of supplementary resources. Beyond solving math problems with accuracy, Mathos AI links students to YouTube math tutorials from popular channels and presents similar questions for additional practice. It reinforces understanding and adds an extra layer of learning materials that allows self-exploration into difficult topics from different angles. By integrating extra materials and focusing on deepening understanding, Mathos AI surpasses the standard resources offered by Mathful, positioning itself as a comprehensive learning platform for students at all levels. Mathful Vs. Mathos AI Pricing Mathos AI's Pricing Structure: Mathos AI offers three tiers of subscription plans to cater to different user needs: Starter Plan (Free): Provides limited features such as MathosPro and basic calculators. Excludes advanced functionalities like the AI Tutor, PDF Homework Helper, and voice input. Basic Plan ($5.99/month, save 52%): Includes 300 MathosMax queries per month, unlimited copy and shortcut features, and a trial of the PDF Homework Helper. title: Quad to host call to discuss second quarter and year-to-date 2026 results; present at an upcoming investor conference
summary: Quad will host a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, to discuss the second quarter 2026 results and participate in investor conference.
body_text: SUSSEX, WI, July 8, 2026 — Quad/Graphics, Inc. (NYSE: QUAD) (“Quad” or the “Company”), a marketing experience company that solves complex marketing challenges for its clients, announced today the date for the release of its second quarter 2026 earnings and its presentation at an upcoming investor conference. Second quarter 2026 earnings date Quad will release its second quarter and year-to-date 2026 financial results after the close of regular market trading on Tuesday, July 28, 2026, and hold a live webcast and conference call to discuss results on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET. Those wishing to participate via the webcast should access the call through the investor relations section of Quad’s website at quad.com/investor-relations. Those wishing to participate via telephone may dial 877-328-5508 (U.S.) or 412-317-5424 (international). Participants may pre-register for the conference call at: https://dpregister.com/sreg/10210027/104504e2940 . The webcast replay will be available through the investor relations section of Quad’s website. Upcoming investor conference Members of Quad management will participate in the Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference at The InterContinental Chicago Magnificent Mile in Chicago on Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Tony Staniak, Quad Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, will present and host one-on-one and small group meetings with investors. The presentation will be accessible through the conference host’s main website at https://www.threepartadvisors.com/midwest . For additional information or to schedule a meeting with management, please contact Quad’s investor relations team at IR@quad.com. Download PDF About Quad Quad (NYSE: QUAD) is a marketing experience, or MX, company that helps brands make direct consumer connections, from household to in-store to online. The company does this through its MX Solutions Suite , a comprehensive range of marketing and print services that seamlessly integrate creative , production and media solutions across online and offline channels. Supported by state-of-the-art technology and data-driven intelligence , Quad simplifies the complexities of marketing by removing friction wherever it occurs along the marketing journey. The company tailors its uniquely flexible, scalable and connected solutions to each clients’ objectives, driving cost efficiencies, improving speed-to-market, strengthening marketing effectiveness and delivering value on client investments. Quad employs approximately 10,000 people in 10 countries and serves approximately 2,100 clients including industry leading blue-chip companies that serve both businesses and consumers in multiple industry verticals, with a particular focus on commerce, including retail , consumer packaged goods , and direct-to-consumer ; financial services ; and health . Quad is ranked among the largest agency companies in the U.S. by Ad Age, buoyed by its full-service media agency, Rise , and creative agency, Betty . Quad is also one of the largest commercial printers in North America, according to Printing Impressions. For more information about Quad, including its commitment to operating responsibly, intentional innovation and values-driven culture, visit quad.com .
